content:
Let \(t_1\) be the first train’s travel time to the meeting point:

\[
t_1=\frac{80}{40}=2\text{ hours}
\]

Let \(t_2\) be the second train’s travel time to the meeting point:

\[
t_2=\frac{80}{80}=1\text{ hour}
\]

The second train leaves \(d\) hours after the first, so:

\[
d=t_1-t_2=2-1=1
\]

\[
\boxed{1\text{ hour}}
\]
